title: Dental PPO Plans Coinsurance for Out-of-Network Practices on Reprocessed New-Plan-Wait Lines
content:
**Clause.** The coinsurance a Dental PPO Plans line reprocessed after a denial for the new waiting period that followed a change to a plan covering its service class (a reprocessed new-plan-wait line) is figured at follows its network status, and so decides the patient share: a basic-class line from an out-of-network practice at the plan's out-of-network basic percentage; a major-class line from an out-of-network practice at the plan's out-of-network major percentage; any other line at the plan's in-network percentage for its service class.

| Plan | Out-of-network basic | Out-of-network major | In-network preventive | In-network basic | In-network major |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Preventive 750 | 0 | 0 | 100 | 0 | 0 |
| Value 1000 | 60 | 0 | 100 | 70 | 0 |
| Classic 1250 | 70 | 40 | 100 | 80 | 50 |
| Plus 1500 | 80 | 50 | 100 | 80 | 50 |
| Premier 2000 | 80 | 50 | 100 | 90 | 60 |
| Elite 2500 | 90 | 60 | 100 | 90 | 60 |

(percentages)

**Points.** A preventive-class line from an out-of-network practice falls under "any other line" and takes the in-network preventive figure. Hypothetical: a basic line from an out-of-network practice on Classic 1250 is figured at 70 percent; from an in-network practice, at 80 percent.
